text:
maya: Quick sync — proposing audit event schema bump to v2 to add RBAC + KMS fields and remove legacy client_id. Need alignment on versioning header, migration approach, and customer validation.

samir: +1 on bump. Can you list exact fields added/removed?

maya: Added: `actor.role`, `actor.role_hierarchy` (list), `resource.labels`, `encryption.kms_key`, `audit_event_version`. Removed: `client_id` (deprecated). Changed: `actor.id` -> allow either `actor.id` or `actor.external_id`.

lee: Will removing client_id break any internal consumers? We have two downstream: billing-collector and customer-audit-webhooks.

alex: billing-collector currently uses `client_id` for cost attribution. We should add a compatibility layer that maps `actor.external_id` -> `client_id` for 90-day grace.

maya: Agree. Plan: runtime will accept v1 and v2 payloads. New producers should emit v2. We'll add `audit_event_version` top-level. For server-side forwards we'll keep `client_id` populated from the mapping for 3 months, then null+log deprecation.

carol: For customer-facing webhooks: do customers get v1 or v2 during canary? We need a handshake/version-negotiation header.

maya: Proposal: webhook subscribers get events with `audit_event_version` included. If a webhook registers `min_supported_audit_schema=1` in the subscription config, we will send v1-compatible envelope. Otherwise send v2. We'll add `Audit-Schema-Version` HTTP header for webhooks and API consumers.

samir: How do we validate customers' expectations? We should provide a validator tool and CI check for prod tests.

lee: I'll own a lightweight schema validator (node/python) that can run against samples and assert required fields. I can add it to the webhook test harness.

maya: Thanks. Also KMS: `encryption.kms_key` will be optional; only set for privacy-sensitive events. We must ensure no plaintext PII gets into non-encrypted payloads. Security please confirm retention rules.

security-bot: Flag: events with field `sensitive:true` must have `encryption.kms_key` or be redacted. Policy change PR needed.

carol: RBAC note — `actor.role` needs canonical enum values to avoid proliferation. Can the infra team publish a role table?

alex: I'll add a canonical role set (admin, maintainer, developer, service, external) and mapping rules for legacy roles.

maya: Migration cadence: draft schema PR this week, implement parser in runtime + validator next sprint, run canary for 2 weeks (internal only), then enable customer canary for selected customers, full rollout in 8 weeks. Need sign-off from billing, webhooks, security, and docs.

samir: Who patches SDKs and event consumers? We need updates to our Go/TS SDKs to surface `audit_event_version` and mapping helpers.

lee: I'll coordinate with SDK owners. Suggest deprecation table in changelog with timeline.

maya: Customer communication: pre-announce in support portal and send targeted emails to webhook subscribers 2 weeks before customer canary. Provide sample v1->v2 diff and validator link.

carol: For compliance, we should publish a validation endpoint where customers can POST sample events and get pass/fail + list of missing fields. That reduces support burden.

alex: Good idea. We can reuse the webhook test harness for that; add an endpoint behind auth.

maya: Example sample event (v2):
```json
{
  "audit_event_version": "2",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T14:22:00Z",
  "actor": { "id": "u_123", "external_id": "acct-987", "role": "service", "role_hierarchy": ["service", "platform"] },
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": { "type": "model", "id": "m_456", "labels": { "env": "prod" } },
  "encryption": { "kms_key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/a/cryptoKeys/k1" },
  "payload": { "changes": "...redacted..." }
}
```

samir: Looks good. For backwards compat, we should include `meta.legacy_client_id` for a transitional period rather than populating `client_id` repeatedly. Less surprise for consumers.

maya: Ok switch to `meta.legacy_client_id` for 90 days, then drop and emit a deprecation notice to logs and metrics.

security-bot: Reminder: any field that can contain PII must be flagged in the schema. Add `sensitive` boolean on payload subtrees.

carol: Testing plan: unit schema tests, end-to-end with the webhook staging fleet, and a simulated replay of 30 days of events to verify no loss. Ops will run the replay.

alex: I'll prepare migration playbook: steps to enable v2, fallback toggles, error thresholds to auto-roll back, and contact list.

maya: Action items:
- maya: open schema PR and include canonical enums (due 1780002500).
- lee: validator + SDK mapping helpers (due 1780003500).
- alex: migration playbook + role table (due 1780003000).
- carol: customer validation endpoint design + docs (due 1780003200).
- samir: coordinate billing mapping and metrics (`billing-collector`) (due 1780003400).

samir: I'll also add telemetry to log any event that fails v2 validation with sampling for analysis.

maya: Last call for objections. If none by EOD PST tomorrow we'll start PRs. :eyes: 

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: schema-pr-checker (id: 98321) — status: pending.

carol: No objections from compliance side. Proceed.

lee: No objections from infra. I'll start the validator work tomorrow.

alex: Ack.

maya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll tag the PR and start the announcement draft.

security-bot: Audit: new schema draft recorded (ticket SEC-2026-72).
